counter.cardRefused: This card could not be verified — search by name, mobile or UHID instead.

rosterOnNow.resolverOff: The roster is not switched on for this hospital yet (ROSTER_RESOLVER_ENABLED is off), so no department can show who is on. The units on take below come from the published take cycles.
rosterOnNow.opdFallbackAll: No duty roster is published yet — the board shows who is sitting in OPD.

rosterOnNow.singleBackup: No second unit — the hospital's duty manager decides
rosterOnNow.notPublished: The take cycle is published, but this department's duty roster is not — so nobody is listed here. Call the head of the unit on take.
